text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 多画风场景20组 · 20 · 梦幻3D · 柠檬汽水玻璃泳池屋 · 柠檬黄 / 水蓝 / 亮白.
Environment: Composition must provide an uncluttered foreground and layered environmental depth. Entire scene is unoccupied: absolutely no people, characters, silhouettes, human reflections, portraits, statues, mannequins, humanoid robots, animals, birds, fish or insects. Plants and flowers allowed. No text, labels, logos, signatures, watermarks, borders or collage. Follow the specified medium faithfully, with an attractive coherent palette and legible architecture. Playful high-end stylized 3D dollhouse-inspired architectural scene, lemon-yellow spiral staircase and translucent aqua glass swimming pool, glossy white curved villa walls and empty sun loungers, polished resin-like material mixed with tactile linen, fresh clear daylight and soft caustics, original uplifting fantasy, no dolls or occupants.
Visual medium: dreamy 3d; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent orthographic architectural elevation or cut section of the principal facade / interior wall. Show openings, vertical structure, floor levels, stair and roof relationships where visible. Readable architectural profile with restrained white margin and a short elevation title.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Reconstruct the SAME scene from reference 1 concept plan, reference 2 original look. Match plan footprint, fixed window/door/stair/furniture positions. Scene: 多画风场景20组 · 20 · 梦幻3D · 柠檬汽水玻璃泳池屋 · 柠檬黄 / 水蓝 / 亮白. One flat architectural orthographic main facade elevation or interior principal wall elevation. Show openings, structural bays, vertical proportions, ceiling profile and material detail. No perspective montage, no furniture moved against the elevation. White page, title INTERIOR ELEVATION or FRONT ELEVATION. Preserve reference materials, light and style. Unseen extension conservative. Empty environment, NO people, animals, silhouettes, statues of humans, no unrelated spaces. Landscape image, no dimensions. IMPORTANT: Reference 2 ORIGINAL image determines artistic medium and color grading: layered paper sculpture, Chinese ink watercolor, retro travel poster, vintage film or dreamy 3D, as applicable. Reference 1 only determines spatial layout. Preserve original palette and artistic medium. No dimension values or scale bars.
